[quote=the_khiravan_republic;61556510][b]Delegation to Dhornaper[/b]

Following recent developments in the northern regions and a renewed focus on regional stability, The Khiravan Republic has announced the dispatch of an official diplomatic delegation to [nation]Dhornaper[/nation]. The delegation, composed of senior diplomatic officials, economic advisors, and security representatives, departed earlier today under military escort, crossing into Dhornaperan territory with the aim of establishing stronger bilateral relations. Khiravan officials have stated hat the mission will focus on opening formal diplomatic channels, exploring economic and trade cooperation and discussing regional security and stability.

[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP[/quote]

[b][u]Delegation Received[/u][/b]

The delegation from Khiravan was welcomed by the Dhora delegation headed by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister Jalayer Khan, who accepted their diplomatic credentials. The Dhora delegation also expressed their interest in bilateral relations, economic cooperation, and regional stability. As such, the Dhora delegation offers the Khiravan Republic an embassy in Shar to start off diplomatic relations between the two countries on a friendly footing. The Dhora delegation would be willing to hear specific proposals from the Khiravan Republic to further mutual goals should the Khiravan Republic be willing to present any.

[b][u]The Ballionic expedition to the state of Irrocco[/u][/b]
It is for the matter of the pursuit of knowledge that many departments of the various prestigious universities of the New Balion Empire have taken upon themselves to launch expeditions to learn, study and share the various unique cultures and peoples out in the world of Erene. It has been noted from various traders and tourists that there are a unique, short-heighted people that apparently live in caves in the rural areas of Irrocco. This has peaked a particular team of anthropologists at the Imperial University of Tandon who have decided upon visiting the country to figure out more. 

A team is ensembled, combined full of anthropologists, ecologists, linguists and other relevant fields of study that will head and visit the nation of Irroco to understand the unique nature of this group. It is led by Dr E. "Indy" Jones with a diplomatic attache led by Sir Boniface Holdstead leading a diplomatic team to help establish formal relations between the Empire and the Islamic state. A small ocean liner is dispatched which takes around 2-3 weeks to reach the seas of Irrocco. It is transmitted through radio that on behalf of Emperor Augustus the 10th, the New Balion Empire wishes to both establish diplomatic relations as well as explore and study various Irroccan peoples.

[nation]Irocco[/nation]

[spoiler=[b]A friend in need[/b]][b]A friend in need[/b]

Ever since total victory in the Astaniran Civil War, SummitONE Solutions has occupied a preeminent place in the Socialist International's administrative hierarchy. How odd it must be that profiteering, morally bankrupt, and ruthlessly capitalistic forces seem to happily coordinate with the workers' revolution.

And yet, it is because of SummitONE's unique position in history that we permit it to fight under the red banner. David Cyriacus, one of the chiefs of the company, was after all a key strategist that enabled Democratic Astaniran forces to obliterate junta forces during the QASIC summer phase offensive, nor should anyone ignore the contributions of Freya Moran who oversaw the occupation of the great city of Astan which accelerated the end of the war.

The existence of these soldiers of fortune are a symptom that reminds us that madness continues to plague this world. However, for as long as they are needed, they must be sought for. as in every revolution is the united front of all personalities formed into unified columns to vanquish the enemy. If these soldiers fight for us, if they [i]die[/i] for us, then so be it.

Since the successful talks between Argo Lo Pilato and the Montfleur government, SummitONE Solutions has used Montfleur as the core anchor of its operations in Western Elseyr, closely coordinating with the main headquarters at Vespurias through a network of front organizations and shell companies. MROS Dynamics, Porthwaite Opportunities, Pax International, Seagate. Sometimes they even go so far as to mask their presence through Sanguinian facades like the Terrasi family's Somare S.p.A. and the Unità Group.

SummitONE Solutions Montfleur, therefore, constitues the company's largest operation based in a non-Socintern nation state. That branch's CEO was a certain Massimo Parziale, a Sanguinian veteran of Astaniran fame who oversaw the bloody vanguard of the fighting at Astanir during the QASIC summer phase offensive. Nowadays, this Parziale busied himself in the management of SummitONE Montfleur's foremost strategic export: False Vespurians.

At the end of the climactic White Tree crisis, the SummitONE-dominated "Separate Group of Forces" which occupied much of Northern Vespuria resettled hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands of Sanguinian soldiers of fortune with falsified birth certificates, Parziale being among them. These Sanguinians, under the benefits of their newfound citizenship documents, then received employment at SummitONE in droves much the same as the Qianxun and the Astanirans before them, swelling that company's ranks into numbers capable of dwarfing entire national militaries.

Now, these same mercenaries would happily take up the duty of paying for their food and board through dangerous service in faraway lands. Except, in this case, a familiar neighbor. Rosenmarkke has called upon SummitONE for aid, and aid shall be granted.

Massimo Parziale, with the backing of Xavier Almstedt's enthusiastic board of directors, would be swiftly sent into Rosenmarkke along with David Cyriacus and Ulf de Mayne to assess the military situation, supply the home front with much needed private security personnel, machine parts, weapons, drones, and other illegal contraband that would be smuggled en masse into Montfleur via Sanguivallis and Gythena.

In order to obfuscate the scale of SummitONE operations, a diversionary trip would be made by the Almstedt family to Eluoja in Gythena announcing an "international initiative" to reduce the human costs of war. While the bulk of the discussion would focus on the Dushkari Civil War raging in South Vespurias, Xavier Almstedt would also bring up the war in the White Straits and its impact on the global economy, and so would authorize a number of "charitable" and "civilian" organizations to aid the beleaguered Rosenmarkket, together with number of personnel sent:

[list]

[b]CS Stretto Bianco[/b]: A risk assessment company that originally managed seismographs and volcanological field testing in climate stressed areas, though recently branching out into technological development for emergency first aid and civil defense; 5,300 personnel

[b]Società per la Difesa dell'Uomo[/b]: A charitable trust first established in 1943 during the tail end of the Old Socialist period in Sanguivallis, supposed dedicated to operating children's hospitals and alternative learning systems in conflict zones; 400 personnel

[b]Gruppo Alternativo[/b]: Security consortium spun off from Somare S.p.A.'s private security division, manufactures armored cars and provides security guards for shopping malls, banks, and other valuable commercial areas; 1,100 personnel

[b]Gruppo Nazionale S.p.A.[/b]: Security consortium formed immediately following the Year of the Five Consuls to maintain supply of security services during the ensuing strikes, nowadays a manufacturer of bulletproof glass and ceramic ballistic plates; 64 personnel

[b]CEdP S.p.A.[/b]: Major seafood corporation originally founded as a guild for Citharo fisherfolk, now mainly known for operating fish farming locations in Gythena and Astanir; 195 personnel

[/list]

Among these companies, CS Stretto Bianco would serve as the main front for SummitONE's operations in Rosenmarkke, with Massimo Parziale to serve as that company's very first president. Due to tumultuous conditions at Tharkønn, CS Stretto Bianco would agree to decentralize its leadership across the country to avoid becoming a victim of the coalition's mass decapitation strikes. However, those corporations that are intended to be legitimate civilian enterprises, namely the Società, would be ordered to proceed to Tharkønn in order to distribute aid and prepare documentaries on the state of the conflict.

In the meantime, Stretto Bianco mercenaries would begin covertly inserting themselves into the Rosenmarkket chain of command, collating reports on military intelligence, news articles, obituaries, basic guides on domestic military equipment, and training exercises in preparation for what might be to come.

Even more covertly, Qianxun agents within the Stretto Bianco would also begin to distribute revolutionary pamphlets and instructions to the Rosenmarkket forces, instructing them to immediately form into soviets to adequately safeguard themselves against imperialist aggression,

Back in Vespurias, SummitONE CEO Honor Almstedt would submit a secret communique to the Council of 99 "thanking" them for enlisting them help of the company to aid its civilian affairs and promising to do "whatever it takes" to preserve the sanctity of life there, even under the relentless bombing runs of the enemy. From the letter's incendiary language, it would be evident to anyone there that the note would in fact be penned by Xavier Almstedt himself.[/spoiler]

Every existing military force within the Empire, no matter how official they are will receive extra training and field exercises to help prepare for any future Military engagement.

[b][u]The Crackdown's Aftermath[/u][/b]

The crackdowns sent shockwaves through the underground communist networks. They had never expected such a thorough infiltration nor that Dhornaper's security apparatus would hijack servers as a means to identify malcontents. The media, as instructed by the government, reported enthusiastically about the police operation. Dhornaper was internally secured.

Externally, Dhornaper hadn't expected a Stuipendian cyber attack after what was, by every metric, an internal policing issue. International communist solidarity was a lot stronger than the security apparatus had expected.

The initial email attachment, masquerading as a passport application form, was innocently opened by an employee from the passport office. After going through it for a few seconds, a command shell popped up, closed quickly, and all hell broke loose. The screen quickly went completely black as their email client was used to send copies of the email and its malicious attachment to every email address in the contacts book. The employee attempted to mash keys to fix things, and then pulled the power plug and put it back to see if things would change. Nothing had. The office IT worker took a look and noticed he was sent an email from them about the time when the employee said it had gone black. Putting two and two together, he realised they had been hacked. He phoned his superiors to alert them of a breach and they contacted the cyber defence centre to report it.

In those few hours of confusion, the malware had spread. Outdated printers and devices were easily compromised. The victims even included senior tech staff who had been compromised after less savvy administrators on the same network as them were compromised. The Stuipendians followed through and got access to the domain firewall and set all inbound connections to dhornaper.gov to ignore. Dhornaper's government website, while technically not hacked as the servers remained uncompromised, were downed.

The cyber defence centre saw the disaster unfolding and quickly ordered Dhornaper's compromised networks to be shut off from the internet while they cooperated with the tech staff at government departments to pick up the pieces. A week later, their work was done. The still inexperienced cyber defence centre used this as a training exercise. After identifying the attack vector, a malicious PDF taking advantage of a zero day in the email client, and spreading through emails and attacks in outdated printer firmware, the hackers were able to gain remote access to a massive swath of Dhornaper's government computers. From there, they succeeded in finding an administrator with access to firewall controls for dhornaper.gov and took the website down. The attack left them burned but using it as a training exercise gave them invaluable experience for the future. The next cyber attack against the government would be much less likely to succeed.

Meanwhile, the banking sector had been alerted about the cyber attack as soon as the cyber defence centre recognised its severity, as had a list of other industries deemed at high risk of cyber sabotage and attack. The timely notices had sent the industries scrambling to prepare for an oncoming attack. A few banks had been compromised anyway; no computer system is ever completely secure. As the first transfers are made to Stuipendian accounts, a few customers notice their bank balances were emptied which caused a flurry of phone calls. The bank's IT staff quickly moved to secure their systems and investigate what had happened. Given the nature of international transfers, the funds had not yet cleared when they were corrected and returned.

The suspicious transfers to legitimate seeming Stuipendian businesses had alerted the government that this wasn't just a ragtag group of hacktivists; no small scale team could have so thoroughly compromised the government and coordinated an attack on the banks. This had all the fingerprints of a state sponsored attack, and the blame lay clearly at the foot of Stuipendia. The Socialist International could be ruled out as no transfers were directed to their country.

When news broke of the cyber attack and Stuipendian involvement, a surge of support erupted for the government. The communist crackdown had just been cast as an operation against foreign involvement. The government played into this and announced a total embargo on Stuipendia and completely blocked out Stuipendian bank accounts from access to Dhornaper.

The Socialist International proclamation didn't help the plight of the communists in Dhornaper. It had sealed their fate: they were, to the majority of Dhornaper, foreign backed terrorists. The prohibited ideologies law, which had been viewed askew by some, had all opposition evaporated now. Fereydun Khan looked like a hero who was securing Dhornaper.

The propagandists were similarly hard at work. They lauded Fereydun Khan as the next Ayub Khan, the founder of the Republic, and called for greater titles to honor his success. The word they left unmentioned but hinted strongly at was "Shah". The calls for the return of the kingdom had begun.

In the mean time, President Fereydun Khan had announced a visit to the Khirqa Sharif mosque, the mosque which houses the cloak of the Prophet and which had recently been renovated. All mullahs and clerics from across the country had been invited to attend the event, which would feature the reopening of it and prayers held. As of yet, the cloak would stay sealed, unopened for almost a hundred years, since Ayub Khan proclaimed the end of the monarchy and the birth of the Republic.

[b]Pan Wuloosyan Airlines Flight 11[/b]

Panwul Flight 11 was landing at Atharchen International Airport on a typical Friday. The nineteenth of May, it was sunny and very warm in the outskirts of Atharchen where AIA was situated, busy and filled with cars and people. In the wake of the Saradir presidency, many were attempting to flee the country elsewhere, and thus the traffic was immense. Despite this, something deeper awaited Atharchen Airport today.

Rosenmarkke was struggling in its conflict with Wuloosya. To the Hebasviri revolution of Sha'dargo Guiñazú, aiding Rosenmarkke was crucial to the upholding of revolutionary values, and as such his second in command agreed to aid them. With increasing restrictions upon aid sent to Rosenmarkke and the difficulty of weapons smuggling, Cmdr. De Lunar ordered for the shipment of 20,000 AK-model weapons and their ammunition to be shipped alongside foodstuffs. To accomplish this through sanctions and no-fly zones, an innovative solution was devised. 

Two semi-trucks approached the cargo entrance of AIA, slowing down to the window after the one infront gained permission to enter. The truck rolled down its window at the stop, a typical Hebasviri man driving it with black aviators on. "Entry pass, please." The officer asked, tone dry and routine. His shift was over soon, eleven hours straight of standing on his feet and talking to truckers. Instead of being handed a typical Entry Sheet, the window of the truck rolled up and slammed forward, crushing through the fence and chain link gate directly onto the runway. The semi behind it followed, two unapproved trucks running rampant on the runway of AIA. 

The officer radioed quickly to halt the flights, calling for reinforcements to stop the vehicles. The two semis sped over the tarmac, past planes loading on passengers and cargo for it's passengers, targeting a Pan Wuloosyan Airlines jet, Flight 11. They were loading the last individuals and suitcases, until the trucks slammed on the breaks, masked gunmen pouring out in droves and demanding the workers put their hands in the air.

Two corraled the workers, forcing them to allow them into the aircraft while the rest moved boxes out of the semis and into the aircraft's cargo hold, yanking out every other piece of cargo that was inside of the hold. Once the cargo was ready, the ten Hebasviri gunmen entered the plane, guns drawn on civilians. One of the stewardesses took self defense classes, beat to unconsciousness by two of the Hebasviri. Once the gunmen moved to guard the emergency exits, the gunman with aviators stepped forward to address the passengers.

"We are not here to hurt anyone else. We will allow women, children, and elderly off of the plane." The gray-furred gunman announced. Quickly, most stood up, the young and middle aged men pushed back into their seats while the rest poured back into the airport. By now, the police had moved all of the innocents out of the building, calling for special forces and counter-terror units to negotiate and handle the hostage-takers. 

Once everyone that had to be taken off was gone, the gunmen closed the plane and breached into the cockpit, weapons drawn. They ordered the pilots to take off, holding them at gunpoint and threatening to fire. One pilot agreed to fly, the other refused, being beaten unconscious as punishment. The two unconscious individuals were also allowed to leave.

Little was done to prevent the aircraft from taking off, the police attempting to fire at the aircraft's engine before it took off failed and before long they were in the air.

[spoiler=[b]The Issue with Bravery[/b]][b]The Issue with Bravery[/b]

"Adventurism has never created anything good." Cui Fang bemoaned, sighing deeply as he crumpled into his chair. It's been a few minutes since news reached him of the social impact of Technate interference in Dhornaper. "I told people that adventurism destroys the people's movements. But did those technocrats listen?"

"It's an awful situation, Comrade Cui." Argo Lo Pilato responded, his eyes glued to his phone, which he had been swiping away at since the crackdown began.

"More than awful, Comrade Lo Pilato. We've just watched yet another revolution be destroyed because it couldn't resist the temptation of being seen. See now? This is why I constantly criticize people for trying to find some common ground among the political Left. We alone are the Left! Everything else is constituted by fundamental misunderstandings of the people's revolution, misunderstandings that lead to abominations like this!"

"Well..."

"Well what?!"

Argo Lo Pilato stood back a moment to recompose himself. When Chairman Cui was angry, it was the sort of anger that would instigate blood vendettas or wars in distant lands. After choosing his words carefully, Lo Pilato carefully put down his phone and dragged a stool over near to Cui, then sitting down upon it. He leaned in, his expression calm but cautious, and he began to speak low and quietly, "Many heroes have been sacrificed today, Comrade Cui, but the spirit of the people's movement still exists among the Dhora, if you'd be willing to help me out here."

"Help you out?" Cui responded, one eyebrow raised high.

"The Astanirans have been observing the situation very closely, Comrade." Lo Pilato continued, "The communist movement still exists in Dhornaper, but it's currently scrambling to survive. We've received reports of one particularly vigorous youth who somehow swam some 35 kilometers to reach one of the Astaniran boats that had been shadowing the Dhora area of responsibility."

"Is he alive?"

"She, comrade. It was a girl. She swam after her brother was shot. Now we have her safe and sound, but only barely. I'm asking for your help now because I believe, no, this entire International believes that more of our fellow comrades can yet be saved so long as we track the Dhora waters, international flights, perhaps even those that opted to take their chances by taking the long way north."

"... You do understand that you're suggesting that we create yet another hostile power against us, right comrade? And so soon after we've elected to involve ourselves in the crisis at Rosenmarkke..."

"I understand it completely." Lo Pilato replied, his voice fully assured. "God is probably a strange concept to you Qianxun folk, Comrade Cui, but it's something important to us Sanguinians. We believe that God is a most wonderful power who directs us to do what must be done for the sake of the human race. This mission is why we practice socialism, and is why I believe that even to save just one more life is absolutely pertinent to the people's revolution."

"I'm not here to judge your believes, comrade." Cui said, rubbing his temples as he stood up from his seat. "So, if you really believe in this mission of yours, then go ahead. I won't oppose you. If you need, for whatever reason, any Qianxun assets in Astanir, contact Yun Caibo. As you can see, I'm rather tired at the moment, so..."

"Yes, yes, that's fine. You just rest there, comrade. Write a new polemic if you want, I'll make sure that my personal endeavors don't trouble a deep mind."

"Oh piss off." Cui exclaimed, waving Lo Pilato off as he quickly shuffled out of the office door. "... Hah... [i]attendre et espérer[/i]..."[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Operation Misericordia[/b]][b]Operation Misericordia[/b]

What remains of Dhora communism has been crushed underfoot by the brutality of monarcho-fascism. While the Socintern continues to hold true to the axiom that a movement cannot simply be destroyed through the destruction of its adherents, this does not mean that sympathetic forces will simply let their fellow brethren be butchered before their very eyes.

Days before, ad hoc rescue operations had already been underway off the coast of Dhornaper, with Astaniran ships and boats lining up to rescue any fleeing Dhora able to find safety aboard their craft. However, this method has led to hefty casualties among fleeing communists, most of whom would either be torn apart piecemeal by the Dhora coast guard, or else simply drown from a lack of skill or stamina in the depths before reaching their ships.

Now therefore, Horano Benir, the current president of the People's Republic of Astanir, has accepted the finalized version of a massive smuggling operation to protect the remnants of Dhornaper's communist movement from total obliteration. With extensive material support from SummitONE Solutions, the Qianxun Socialist Ethics Commission, and individual backers in the Sanguinian Social Renaissance Party, the Astaniran Democracy Navy would launch Operation Misericordia, a massive repatriation campaign to save any fleeing Dhora attempting to escape either by sea from the south or by land from the north.

In the south, Astaniran replenishment ships and boats would be sent to hover just beyond the Dhora area of responsibility, with specialized equipment such as covert submersibles to get in within just hundreds of meters of the Dhora coastline before switching to closed-circuit rebreathers to approach the shoreline undetected. Due to the immense complexity of this task, the actual divers themselves would be predominantly sourced from Red Guard troops serving in the University of Qianxun Project 661 Lake Observatories, an institution renowned for possessing [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=rmb/postid=60297287]some of the finest aquanauts in the world[/url].

Once at shore, instead of calling upon fleeing Dhora to swim, the divers would instead quickly fit any communists they could find with diving gear and organizing them into "teams". They're quickly taught the most basic steps for diving, the tools to operate, the use of buoyancy compensators during emergencies, hand signals, and anything else that will be necessary to save their lives. Then, after a quick test, the Dhora are ordered to walk into the shoreline where they would be escorted all the way back to the submersibles, and then back to the Astaniran vessels bound for Zurayq.

In the north, things would be more simplified, with SummitONE operatives and Balizids from the Emirate of Wali Zurayq being enlisted to patrol the northern fringes of the Dhora border for fleeing communists, whom they would flag down and intercept, then carefully escort along the treacherous, unbeaten path towards Zurayq. While SummitONE operatives would propose expanding this mission to involve border skirmishing to try and rescue even more communists, the Socintern Presidium would reject anything more as being far too incendiary for their liking.[/spoiler]
